thread:
Devon: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortem — I sketched a proposal to batch remediation handoffs into the next two sprints to reduce context switching. TL;DR: group similar infra fixes + assign a single steward per batch.

Maria: +1 to batching, we burn too much time re-explaining incident context each handoff. can we list the must-fix tickets first?

Devon: Yes. Initial list (will create tickets if folks confirm): RW-4821 (cache eviction hardening), RW-4822 (kv-cache TTL audit), RW-4823 (fallback routing test infra), RW-4824 (alert deduping).

Alex: I can take RW-4821 and RW-4822 as steward for the "cache" batch. I'll add acceptance criteria and link runbook updates.

Keisha: I'll own RW-4823 (routing tests) but prefer to pair with SRE for infra changes. tagging @Riley for pairing.

Riley: Yup, I can pair on RW-4823. Also suggest we set a single SLA for the batch: 3 sprint points per ticket, target end of sprint-2 for rollout.

oncall-bot: Reminder: new postmortem follow-up list created in #postmortems. Next check-in scheduled in 72h.

Devon: RACI sketch for the batch (draft):
```
Ticket    Responsible   Accountable   Consulted      Informed
RW-4821   Alex          Maria         SRE(oncall)    Eng+PM
RW-4822   Alex          Maria         Infra team     Eng+PM
RW-4823   Keisha        Devon         Riley,SRE      Eng+PM
RW-4824   TBD           Devon         Support        Eng+PM
```

Maria: This looks good. For RW-4824 I can triage with support and create the ticket; I'll assign a steward after triage.

Alex: I linked RW-4821 and RW-4822 to a parent ticket RW-4900 (postmortem-remediation-batch-1) and added sprint labels `sprint-12` and `remediation-batch`. please review the ticket descriptions.

Keisha: Can we get a quick pre-handoff checklist? what do we need to hand off to the steward so they can act immediately?

Devon: Good call. Pre-handoff checklist (short):
- Jira ticket with acceptance criteria and rollback plan
- Runbook link + last incident timeline excerpt
- Owner contact + pairing window
- Test plan + smoke test commands
I added this to RW-4900 comments.

Maria: I'll post a short checklist template in RW-4900 and tag owners. Also propose weekly 30m sync during the batch window to catch blockers.

Riley: FYI spotted a recurring pattern: cache TTLs and fallback routing both fail >50% in high qps windows. we should prioritize a load reproduction test early. adding to RW-4900 notes.

Devon: Agree. Action items summary:
- Alex: create detailed ACs for RW-4821/RW-4822 (due EOD tomorrow)
- Keisha + Riley: test plan for RW-4823 + pairing slot (due 48h)
- Maria: create RW-4824 after support triage + checklist template (due 72h)
- Devon: update RW-4900 with RACI and schedule recurring syncs

Alex: I'll post PRs for runbook changes once ACs are up.

Keisha: slot booked with Riley for pairing: Tue 10:30PT.

Maria: created RW-4824 and assigned it to Support-Triage. link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-4824

Devon: Thanks. Let's reconvene at the scheduled weekly sync and update this thread with blockers. :thumbsup:

Riley: Noted. I'll start a short load repro run today and post logs in RW-4900 if anything obvious shows up.

oncall-bot: Check-in: follow-up tickets RW-4821,RW-4822,RW-4823,RW-4824 added to sprint board. Next sync in 7 days.
